# Assets · Icons

2 files under `assets/Icons/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for lucide--calendar.svg>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

Lucide icons vendored for `astro-icon` (`lucide--calendar`, `lucide--map-pin`): 24 × 24, 2px stroke, round caps and joins. Every other icon comes from the `lucide-react` package.

Their ink is `currentColor`, so inline them in code and set the color there: `color-fob-gold` beside dates and venues, `color-fob-subtle` for supporting meta. Shown here as images, they render black.
